settings.account.notCollected: Not collected — HollowChat never asks for one.
settings.account.savePasswordHint: This is the only time we'll show it. Your old password no longer works.
settings.account.generateNewHint: HollowChat has no user-chosen passwords — we'll generate a new random one and show it once. Your current password stops working immediately.
settings.account.recoveryHint: There is no email or phone number on file, so there is no password reset. Losing your password means losing the account.
settings.account.twoFactorOff: Not enabled. Add an authenticator app for extra login security.
settings.account.scanTitle: Scan this with your authenticator app
settings.account.scanHint: Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password — anything that supports TOTP.
settings.account.backupCodesHint: Each code works once, if you lose access to your authenticator app. There's no other way back into the account — store these somewhere safe.
settings.account.disableHint: Enter a current code from your app, or a backup code, to confirm.
settings.account.regenerateHint: This invalidates your old backup codes. Confirm with a current code.
settings.account.twoFactorOn: Enabled — your login also asks for a code from your authenticator app.
settings.account.linkedDevicesHint: Move your encryption keys to a new device without losing your conversations.
settings.account.waitingForDeviceHint: On the new device, sign in with this account, then choose "Link with another device" when asked.
settings.account.confirmCodeMatch: Confirm this code matches on both devices
settings.account.keysSent: Keys sent. The new device can now read your conversations.
settings.account.badCode: That code didn't work — try again
settings.privacy.activityStatusHint: Let friends see what you're playing, watching, or listening to via Rich Presence. Off clears it for everyone but you.
settings.privacy.extensionHint: Adds Rich Presence for YouTube, SoundCloud, Spotify, and Twitch — shows up next to game activity, gated by the same toggle above. Browsers block silent extension installs, so this is a two-minute manual step, not a store listing.
settings.privacy.extensionStep1: Click below to reveal the extension folder
settings.privacy.dataCollectedHint: Username and a password hash. Nothing else.
settings.privacy.dmStorageHint: End-to-end encrypted (X3DH + Double Ratchet). The server only ever sees ciphertext.
settings.privacy.channelStorageHint: Message text and file attachments are end-to-end encrypted with a per-channel sender key, shared directly between members — the server only ever sees ciphertext. A member removed from the server can still read messages sent with a key they already received until the channel is next re-keyed.
settings.privacy.ipLoggingHint: None. HollowChat doesn't record your IP address or device info against your account, even for active sessions — a server compromise can't link your account to a network or a device.
settings.privacy.extensionFolderFailed: Couldn't open the extension folder — this only works in the desktop app

settings.billing.voidShardsHint: {used} of {total} assigned. Boosting a server raises its custom emoji slots for everyone in it.

settings.billing.shardsPremiumOnly: Void Shards are a Premium perk

settings.moderation.reasonMessagesHint: The reason text, quoted messages, and attachments for this report are end-to-end sealed to an offline moderator key — this panel (and the server) never holds it. Fetch the sealed row and decrypt it on an air-gapped machine with
settings.moderation.overviewHintA: Report contents are sealed to a key this app never holds — decrypt them offline with
settings.moderation.overviewHintB: This just tracks who reported whom and lets you open a reply DM as Hollow Support.
